item.title: Sask. RCMP seize 9.1 million illicit cigarettes in highway traffic stop
item.description: A 41-year-old truck driver from Ontario was charged after being pulled over on Highway 16 and found carrying 23 pallets of unstamped tobacco.

item.title: Saskatoon murder trial adjourned after accused hospitalized
item.description: Michael Smillie's lawyer confirmed on Thursday that his client, who is in the midst of a first-degree murder trial, remains in hospital.

item.title: Sask. government invests $1.85 million in SPS through safer communities initiative
item.description: In 2025, the SPS dispatched more than 108,000 calls for service. McBride attributed the amount of calls to a growing population.

item.title: Explore the local arts scene: Five things to do this weekend in Saskatoon, Jan. 30 – Feb. 1
item.description: Take in a variety show, a jazz concert, a Ukrainian art workshop, an exclusive skating evening and a tribute to Joni Mitchell.

item.title: Sask. flatlands to Olympic heights: What a journey for Team Canada freestyle skier Maia Schwinghammer
item.description: "It’s pretty crazy to be headed to the Games as an athlete from Saskatchewan.”

item.title: 'Long, hard fight': $27M settlement agreement next step for Sask. residential school survivors
item.description: The feds say the court "will look at whether the settlement is fair, reasonable, and in the best interests" of former students and family.

item.title: Councillor says federal funding needed for energy to make DEED happen
item.description: Ward 10 Coun. Zach Jeffries noted that property taxes would go up without the funding, and that the project's timeline is "not imminent."

item.title: Rosenfeldt found not guilty in shooting death of Saskatoon woman Nykera Brown
item.description: A Saskatoon judge said she was left with reasonable doubt that Andrew Rosenfeldt, 28, shot and killed his girlfriend on Nov. 15, 2022.

item.title: Moe says 'unified effort' at First Ministers Meeting, talks up Saskatchewan's resource development
item.description: "We've been in the starter blocks for a decade, and now the race is on," Moe said about a federal push for resource development.

item.title: Saskatoon men get 10-year sentences in killing of James 'Ed' Swift
item.description: Colton Lischka and Ashtin Ritzand were convicted of manslaughter in the stabbing death of Swift in the RM of Corman Park in 2022.
